name: AMBEST
recent: Ambest 在 2026 年 11 月撤回 ESOS 的额外上市申请，此前已将 ESOS 规模从最多 30% 缩减至最多 10%，并排除董事、大股东及首席执行官的参与资格。公司 2026 财年第二季度净利按季大增 801.8% 至 344 万令吉，营收按季增长 19.2% 至 2428 万令吉。新闻指出半导体订单超出产能，公司正加速扩产。
notable: 规模最高为已发行股份的 10%，随后于 11 月 11 日撤回相关额外上市申请。
2026 财年第二季度净利按季增长 801.8% 至 344 万令吉，营收按季增长 19.2% 至 2428 万令吉。
媒体报道公司因半导体订单超出产能而加速扩产。
risks: 董事总经理 Tan Beng Beng 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日及 11 日分别申报减持 1375 万股及 150 万股。
执行董事 Lim Eng Guan 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日及 11 日分别申报减持 1375 万股及 150 万股。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 23 日更改财政年度结束日。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 2428 万令吉，按季增长 19.2%；净利为 344 万令吉，按季增长 801.8%；净利率从上一季度的 1.9% 升至 14.2%。

recent_en: Ambest withdrew the additional listing application for its ESOS in November 2026, after reducing the scheme size from up to 30% to up to 10% and removing eligibility for directors, major shareholders and the CEO. 2Q26 net profit surged 801.8% QoQ to RM3.44 million on revenue of RM24.28 million, up 19.2% QoQ. News reports say semiconductor orders are outpacing capacity and the company is accelerating expansion.
notable_en: Proposed an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares, then withdrew the related additional listing application on 11 November.
2Q26 net profit rose 801.8% QoQ to RM3.44 million, with revenue up 19.2% QoQ to RM24.28 million.
Media reported the company is accelerating capacity expansion as semiconductor orders exceed capacity.
risks_en: Managing Director Tan Beng Beng reported disposing of 13.75 million shares on 3 September 2026 and 1.5 million shares on 11 September 2026.
Executive Director Lim Eng Guan reported disposing of 13.75 million shares on 3 September 2026 and 1.5 million shares on 11 September 2026.
The company changed its financial year end on 23 September 2026.
earnings_en: For 2Q26 ended 30 June, revenue was RM24.28 million, up 19.2% QoQ; net profit was RM3.44 million, up 801.8% QoQ; net margin rose to 14.2% from 1.9% in the previous quarter.
